'''Alejandra Reynoso''' is an American actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Alejandra Reynoso was born on April 19, 1994 in Los Angeles County, California, USA. She is an actress. She is voicing [[Liko]], a protagonist of {{aniseries|HZ}}.

On February 10, 2025, she was nominated for a Hermes award for the Best Voice Performance for an Animated Series category for her performance as Liko, with her going on to win the award on April 3, 2025.
